_comment_facility_desc: Define the physical layout of your manufacturing facility

facility._comment_cells: Number of production cells in the facility
facility._comment_total_workstations: Total number of workstations across all cells
facility._comment_workstations_per_cell: Number of workstations in each cell

_comment_mqtt_desc: Configure connection to your MQTT broker (running in Docker)

mqtt._comment_host: IP address of your MQTT broker (change this to match your setup)
mqtt._comment_port: MQTT broker port (default: 1883 for non-SSL, 8883 for SSL)
mqtt._comment_username: MQTT username (null if no authentication required)
mqtt._comment_password: MQTT password (null if no authentication required)

_comment_barcode_desc: Configure the barcode scanner service integration

barcode_scanner_service._comment_host: IP address of barcode scanner service (usually same as MQTT broker)
barcode_scanner_service._comment_log_directory: Directory where Excel logs will be saved
barcode_scanner_service._comment_log_all_topics: Log all MQTT topics to Excel
barcode_scanner_service._comment_auto_start: Automatically start service when application launches

_comment_opc_ua_desc: Configure OPC UA connection to KepServerEX for PLC data

opc_ua_service._comment_mqtt_host: MQTT broker IP for publishing PLC data
opc_ua_service._comment_subscription_interval: OPC UA subscription interval in milliseconds
opc_ua_service._comment_auto_start: Automatically start service when application launches

_comment_performance_desc: Adjust these values to optimize performance

performance._comment_agent_inbox_timeout: Agent message processing timeout in seconds
performance._comment_eventbus_tick_interval: Event bus tick interval in seconds
performance._comment_state_stability_delay: State stability check delay in seconds

_comment_production_desc: Define production cycle time and takt time targets

production._comment_target_cycle_time: Target cycle time per workstation in seconds
production._comment_target_takt_time: Target takt time (customer demand rate) in seconds

_comment_topics_desc: Define MQTT topic names for different data streams

topics._comment_inspection_station: Topic for inspection station barcode scans
topics._comment_ws_cycle_time_prefix: Prefix for workstation cycle time topics

_comment_note1: Lines starting with '_comment' are ignored by the application
_comment_note2: After editing, save this file and restart the application
_comment_note3: Make sure your Docker services (MQTT, Node-RED, InfluxDB, Grafana) are running
_comment_note4: IP addresses must match your network configuration
